summary: Yopass is a self-hosted utility designed for encrypted transmission of sensitive data such as passwords, confidential notes, and files. It ensures that shared information self-destructs after a single view or a defined expiration time, preventing persistent storage risks. The service is written in Go and distributed as a container image.
goodFor: It suits administrators and teams who need a secure, internal mechanism to transmit credentials or configuration files without relying on third-party cloud services.
watchOut: You will need to manage your own expiration policies and network access controls, as exposed instances can become vectors for data exfiltration if left unsecured.
deployNotes: Container deployment is straightforward via Docker, typically requiring a reverse proxy for TLS termination and optionally a key-value store depending on the persistence backend chosen.
